# lorrgs

Lorrgs cooldown timeline and composition ranking CLI.

## Global options

Pass these before the subcommand: `lorrgs --pretty <command> ...`.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--pretty` | boolean | false | Pretty-print JSON for human reading. Default output is compact JSON. |
| `--compact` | boolean | false | Truncate long prose strings to reduce payload size. URLs, talent strings and commands stay whole. |
| `--fields` | str (repeatable) |  | Return only selected fields (dot paths). Repeat or pass comma-separated values. |
| `--fields-strict` | boolean | false | Fail when a requested --fields dot-path is missing from the payload. |
| `--profile` | str |  | Output profile preset: agent (default compact JSON) or human (pretty JSON). |
| `--compact-max-chars` | int range [40<=x<=10000] | 280 | Maximum string length before --compact truncation adds an ellipsis. |

## lorrgs doctor

Report Lorrgs auth posture, endpoints, and per-surface capability state.

## lorrgs search

Search Lorrgs by explicit URL/ref or by spec/boss terms.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | str | required | Search Lorrgs routes, Warcraft Logs report refs, or spec/boss text. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | int range [1<=x<=50] | 5 | Maximum results to return. |

## lorrgs resolve

Resolve a Lorrgs query conservatively: an ambiguous query stays unresolved, its top row a low-confidence match.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | str | required | Resolve a Lorrgs URL/ref or spec/boss query into a next command. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | int range [1<=x<=50] | 5 | Maximum candidates to list; ambiguity is judged over all of them. |

## lorrgs spec-ranking

Fetch top-parse cooldown timelines for one spec on one encounter.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spec_slug` | str | required | Lorrgs spec slug, e.g. mage-frost; any provider's spelling (frost-mage, Frost Mage, BeastMastery) is translated. |
| `boss_slug` | str | required | Lorrgs boss slug, e.g. chimaerus-the-undreamt-god. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--difficulty` | str | mythic | mythic or heroic; defaults to mythic. |
| `--metric` | str |  | Metric override, e.g. dps or hps. Defaults by spec role. |

| `boss_slug` | str | required | Lorrgs boss slug, e.g. chimaerus-the-undreamt-god. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--difficulty` | str | mythic | mythic or heroic; defaults to mythic. |
| `--metric` | str |  | Metric override, e.g. dps or hps. Defaults by spec role. |

## lorrgs comp-ranking

Fetch top composition ranking rows for an encounter.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `boss_slug` | str | required | Lorrgs boss slug, e.g. chimaerus-the-undreamt-god. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | int range [1<=x<=50] | 20 | Maximum report rows to request. |
| `--role` | str (repeatable) |  | Role count filter <role>.<op>.<n>, role tank/heal/mdps/rdps, op eq/gt/gte/lt/lte, e.g. heal.gte.4; repeatable. |
| `--spec` | str (repeatable) |  | Spec count filter <spec>.<op>.<n>, e.g. mage-frost.gte.1; any provider's spec spelling works; repeatable. |
| `--kill-time-min / --killtime-min` | int range [x>=0] | 0 | Minimum kill time in seconds; 0 = no bound. |
| `--kill-time-max / --killtime-max` | int range [x>=0] | 0 | Maximum kill time in seconds; 0 = no bound. |

## lorrgs user-report-fights

Fetch selected fights from an already-cached Lorrgs user report.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `report_ref` | str | required | Warcraft Logs report URL, Lorrgs user_report URL, or report code already cached by Lorrgs. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--fight` | str |  | Dot-separated fight ids, e.g. 2.4.15. Defaults to fight id from URL. |
| `--fight-id` | int (repeatable) |  | A fight id; repeatable, the same as --fight 2.4.15. |
| `--player` | str |  | Optional dot-separated player source ids, e.g. 1.5.20. |
| `--type` | str |  | Optional report view type, e.g. damage-done. Defaults to type from URL. |
